summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions filed Prospectus Supplement No. 2 under Rule 424(b)(5), amending its Form F-3 shelf registration covering up to $38,160,000 of Class A shares issuable to Mapie Wind Limited under an August 7, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement. The filing reflects Amendment No. 1, resetting the Floor Price from $16.00 back to $0.10 after October 2026 1-for-20 and November 2026 1-for-8 consolidations. Purchases of up to $36,000,000 occur over a two-year commitment at 50% of the lower of the agreement-date closing price or the trailing 180-day low. This is a routine equity line takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and floor mechanics.
